tools.name: get_isbn_offer
tools.description: Returns the three ISBN packs (simple, barcode, premium) with prices in USD and FCFA (XOF), what each includes, delivery delay, payment methods, supported languages and contact.

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: Returns the secure page where the CUSTOMER pays for an ISBN pack. card = Stripe Checkout link; mobile_money = order page with the Mobile Money form. This tool never performs or initiates a payment and collects no payment data.

tools.name: get_required_book_info
tools.description: Lists the fields the customer fills in on the thank-you page after payment, so an agent can help prepare them in advance.

tools.name: faq
tools.description: Answers common questions about the ISBN service. Optional keyword filter.
